forms.label: Conditional safety instruction
forms.japanese: 安全なら元栓を閉め、火を消してください。どのスイッチにも触らないでください。
forms.english: If it's safe, close the valve and put out the flame; don't touch any switch.
forms.explanation: 安全なら means “if it is safe.” 閉め is the linking stem of 閉める, followed by 消してください, a direct request to put out the flame. どのスイッチにも … ない means “not any switch”; 触らないでください is a negative request.

forms.label: Negative requests
forms.japanese: たばこを吸わないでください。ライターも使わないでください。
forms.explanation: 吸わないでください and 使わないでください are negative requests: ない-form + でください. も adds “either” to the second prohibition. The English face joins the two Japanese sentences as one warning.

forms.label: Conditional danger
forms.japanese: だれかが何かに火をつけたら、危険になります。
forms.english: If anyone lights anything, there will be danger.
forms.explanation: 〜たら marks the condition “if anyone lights anything.” 危険になります states the consequence, “there will be danger.” This is a warning, not a claim that a fire has already started.

forms.label: Report a possible gas leak
forms.japanese: 屋台広場でガス漏れの可能性があります。
forms.english: There's a possible gas leak at a food truck park.
forms.explanation: で marks the location. ガス漏れの可能性があります means “there is a possibility of a gas leak,” preserving the report as possible rather than confirmed.

forms.label: Location and identification
forms.japanese: 赤いTシャツを着て、正面入口でお待ちします。
forms.english: I'll wait for you at the main entrance in a red T-shirt.
forms.explanation: 赤いTシャツを着て links clothing to the waiting action. 正面入口で marks where Alex will wait. お待ちします is the polite form used for his own action to the operator.

speakingObjectives: Warn Mauricio about the strong gas smell near his cylinder; ask him to close the valve and put out the flame only if safe, without touching any switch.
Move people away from the food truck; tell them not to smoke or use lighters, and explain the danger if anyone lights anything.
After everyone is away from the truck, dial 911 in the San José, Costa Rica source scene; report a possible gas leak at the food-truck park.
Give Daniela the exact location in front of the main entrance next to the parking lot, and identify yourself by the red T-shirt while waiting at the entrance.
